title: Food To-Go
description: Need to cook out on the road? Try a Skillet. You can either place the Skillet over a Campfire or Stove and place up to a full stack of raw food on it at once, or you can hold the raw food in your offhand, and use the Skillet near a source of heat. Unlike Furnaces and Smokers, Skillets do not consume fuel to cook.
